R115 (review 2026-09-26 r107-r112, queue item 5) - tournament schedule slot semantics on every PS4 source that ships a populated tournament
table (R113 source list; hash de-duplication). Tables: championsschedule, spenglerschedule, wcschedule (worldchamp / worldjunior are
reported by row count). Per table and round: rows, slot ids, pairs, per-slot game counts, dates; round-0 groups = connected components of the
round-0 pair graph. Join tests (each reported as agree / disagree, never adopted):
  J1  slot = rank by `index` among the tournament league's own members (stockleagues name WorldCup / TXT_SPENGLER_CUP / TXT_CHAMPIONS_LEAGUE);
      agreement test: every round-0 group maps into one `divisiongroup` value and each value into one group (where the league has >1 value).
  J2  Spengler only: slot = position inside the `divisiongroup` (groups ordered by id, members by index) - consistent with the groups by
      construction; reported so J1 and J2 can be compared.
  JC  CHL participant candidate set = distinct `teamid` of `stockteamjerseys` rows with ischampionsleague = 1; its size and league mix; under
      "slot = rank by index within that set", the number of round-0 groups holding two clubs of the same league (diagnostic of that reading).
  Spengler placeholder structure: ids >= member count, the games they occur in, and whether each pairs with the one club absent from the
  day-1 game of its group (the 'winner / loser of game k' reading); knockout rounds: slot ids per round and pairing pattern.
Read-only. Usage: python r115_tournament_slots.py <out.json>
